skills/client-archetypes.description: Use this to match your tone to the buyer type. Six types. Same deal, different music.

skills/cold-outreach.description: Use this for first messages to strangers. DMs, email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp.

skills/dark-tactics-defense.description: Use this to spot manipulation aimed at you. And to keep your own moves on the honest side.

skills/deal-router.description: Use this as the always-on brain. Read the last message, find the first match, act. Ten seconds.

skills/discovery-power.description: Use this to find out what someone wants, fears, or hides. Without interrogating them.

skills/frame-control.description: Use this when you feel needy, the other side tests you, or you are losing control of the talk.

skills/objection-slayer.description: Use this when someone pushes back. Price, trust, timing, rivals, guarantees, silence.

skills/operator-mindset.description: Use this before you send anything important, and after every rejection.

skills/price-anchor.description: Use this when price comes up. Set the first number. Hold it. Move in structure, never in discounts.

skills/reading-people.description: Use this to read true intent in chat. Who is real, who is shopping, who runs a trick on you.

skills/risk-reversal.description: Use this to close hesitant buyers. Move the risk from them to you. The strongest close in low-trust markets.

skills/trust-from-zero.description: Use this when a stranger has no reason to believe you. Builds trust with structure instead of big claims.

skills/walk-away-power.description: Use this when terms are impossible, the buyer turns rude, or the thread is dead.
